description: This file defines a final Java class 'Parameter' which models the <parameter> element in an XML configuration. It includes constructors and accessor methods for parameter name and value, and throws exceptions if attributes are missing or empty.

classes.name: Parameter
classes.description: Immutable class representing a parameter element with name and value attributes parsed from XML.

methods.name: Parameter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Parameter object from an XML Element, extracting and validating 'name' and 'value' attributes.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name attribute of the parameter.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value attribute of the parameter.
